questions.question_text: Which among the following processes is not involved in the preparation of absorbent cotton wool I.P. ?
questions.explanation: Percolation is an extraction process used for tinctures and extracts, not for preparing absorbent cotton wool.

questions.question_text: Antidote for organophosphorus poisoning
questions.explanation: Atropine is a competitive antagonist at muscarinic acetylcholine receptors and is the primary antidote for organophosphate poisoning.

questions.question_text: Choose the topical formulation from the following.
questions.explanation: Collodions are liquid preparations containing pyroxylin applied externally to the skin.

questions.question_text: Metric equivalent of 1 gallon
questions.explanation: One Imperial gallon is approximately equivalent to 4.546 liters (commonly cited as 4.5 Lit.).

questions.question_text: Which among the following cannot be used as a propellant in aerosols ?
questions.explanation: Ethylene oxide is a sterilizing and alkylating agent, highly toxic and flammable, and not used as an aerosol propellant.

questions.question_text: A ball mill works on the principle of
questions.explanation: Ball mills reduce particle size through a combination of impact (falling balls) and attrition (sliding and rolling of balls).

questions.question_text: A 22/60 powder is
questions.explanation: A powder where all particles pass through sieve number 22 and not more than 40% through sieve number 60 is classified as a moderately coarse powder.

questions.question_text: Which among the following is a liquid mixer ?
questions.explanation: Propeller mixers are designed for mixing liquids and low-viscosity solutions.

questions.question_text: Orange tincture is prepared by
questions.explanation: Fresh orange peel tincture is officially prepared by simple maceration.

questions.question_text: Exsiccation is

options.A: Removal of water of crystallisation from hydrated crystalline substances
options.B: Conversion of anhydrous substance to its hydrated form
options.C: Conversion of solid directly to its vapour

questions.explanation: Exsiccation involves heating a hydrated crystalline substance to remove its water of crystallization.

questions.question_text: In the distillation still for the preparation of water for injection, the purpose of fitting baffles is

options.A: To prevent excessive concentration of salts
options.C: To make it free from carbon dioxide
options.D: To prevent the entry of pyrogens in the distillate

questions.explanation: Baffles trap water droplets and pyrogens, preventing them from being carried over into the final distillate.

questions.question_text: Disadvantage of vacuum filter

options.A: Not suitable for thermo labile materials
options.D: Frequent cleaning of filter is required

questions.explanation: Standard simple vacuum filtration setups typically lose volatile solvents through vaporization under reduced pressure unless specialized condensers are used, meaning solvent recovery is difficult or not possible.

questions.question_text: In dry heat sterilisation, microorganisms are destroyed by
questions.explanation: Dry heat sterilization destroys microorganisms through oxidative processes of cellular components.

questions.question_text: Uneven colour distribution in tablets is
questions.explanation: Mottling is a tablet defect characterized by an uneven distribution of color on the tablet surface.

questions.question_text: As per I.P., the weight variation limit for a 500 mg tablet is
questions.explanation: According to the Indian Pharmacopoeia, the percentage weight variation limit for un-coated or film-coated tablets weighing between 250 mg and more is $\pm 7.5\%$.

questions.question_text: As per I.P. the Disintegration time for a hard gelatin capsule should be within
questions.explanation: Hard gelatin capsules typically have a disintegration time limit of 15 minutes unless specified otherwise.

questions.question_text: Which among the following is a dead bacterial vaccine ?
questions.explanation: Cholera vaccine is prepared from killed (inactivated/dead) bacteria, whereas BCG and smallpox are live attenuated vaccines.

questions.question_text: Mantoux test is a diagnostic test for
questions.explanation: The Mantoux test is a standardized intradermal skin test used to screen for tuberculosis infection.

questions.question_text: In a prescription, subscription means

options.B: Names and quantities of prescribed ingredients
options.C: Instruction to the patient for drug administration

questions.explanation: Subscription consists of directions given by the prescriber to the dispenser regarding how to compound or prepare the medication.

questions.question_text: Child dose is calculated on the basis of child’s body weight in
questions.explanation: Clark's formula calculates the pediatric dose based on the child's body weight in pounds.

questions.question_text: Gregory’s powder is a
questions.explanation: Gregory's powder (Compound Rhubarb Powder) is traditionally dispensed as a bulk powder.

questions.question_text: Bentonite is an ingredient in
questions.explanation: Bentonite magma is used as a suspending agent in Calamine Lotion I.P.

questions.question_text: Which among the following is a nonessential amino acid ?
questions.explanation: Glycine can be synthesized by the human body, making it a nonessential amino acid, whereas valine, lysine, and leucine are essential.

questions.question_text: Find the anionic emulsifying agent.
questions.explanation: Sodium lauryl sulphate is a classic anionic surfactant widely used as an emulsifying agent.

questions.question_text: Wool fat is
questions.explanation: Wool fat (anhydrous lanolin) acts as an absorption base because it can absorb water to form water-in-oil emulsions.

questions.question_text: Unnas paste is
questions.explanation: Unna's paste is formulated as a zinc gelatin paste/jelly used in dermatological treatments.

questions.question_text: Which among the following is not applicable to theobroma oil suppository bases ?
questions.explanation: Theobroma oil (cocoa butter) melts at body temperature rather than dissolving in body fluids.

questions.question_text: Find the depilating agent.
questions.explanation: Barium sulphide is a chemical depilatory agent used for removing hair.

questions.question_text: Which among the following is not a correct statement ?

options.A: Chlorocresol can be used as an antibacterial agent in multi dose parenteral preparations
options.B: Intra thecal injections are given in to the sub arachnoid space
options.C: Pyrogens can be destroyed by heating up to 100°C
options.D: Large volume parenteral preparations should not contain any preservatives

questions.explanation: Pyrogens are heat-stable and are not destroyed by boiling at 100°C; they require temperatures above 250°C for destruction.

questions.question_text: Eye ointment base B.P. does not contain
questions.explanation: Eye ointment base B.P. typically contains liquid paraffin, wool fat, and white soft paraffin (avoiding colored or less refined bases like yellow soft paraffin).

questions.question_text: Which among the following is not used in the limit test for iron ?
questions.explanation: Mercuric chloride is used in the limit test for arsenic, not for iron.

questions.question_text: Which among the following is not correct about Barium Sulphate reagent ?

options.A: It is used in the limit test for sulphate
options.C: It contains Barium chloride, water, sulphate free alcohol and Potassium sulphate
options.D: It is not used in the limit test for sulphate

questions.explanation: Statement D claims it is not used in the limit test for sulphate, which contradicts the standard use of barium sulfate reagent/turbidity method for sulphate limit tests.

questions.question_text: Glycerol is used in the essay of Boric acid because

options.A: Presence of glycerol causes Boric acid to behave as a strong mono protic acid
options.B: Glycerol promotes the solubility of the indicator

questions.explanation: Boric acid is a very weak acid, but in the presence of glycerol, it forms a complex acid that behaves as a strong monoprotic acid capable of being titrated with sodium hydroxide.

questions.question_text: Among the following which buffer system is having the highest pH value ?
questions.explanation: Ammonia buffer systems generally maintain alkaline pH ranges typically between 8.3 and 10.2, which is higher than the typical ranges for acetic acid, phosphate, or imidazole buffers.

questions.question_text: Oil of vitriol is
questions.explanation: Oil of vitriol is the historical name for concentrated sulfuric acid ($H_2SO_4$).

questions.question_text: Talc is

options.A: Purified natural hydrous Magnesium silicate containing small amount of Aluminium silicate and iron

questions.explanation: Talc is a purified natural hydrous magnesium silicate with small amounts of aluminum and iron silicates.

questions.question_text: Sublimed sulphur is used for
questions.explanation: Sublimed sulfur is classically employed as a scabicide and keratolytic agent in dermatology.

questions.question_text: Sodium chloride injection I.P. contains

options.A: 270 millimoles per Lit. of sodium and chloride ions
options.B: 150 millimoles/Lit. of sodium and chloride ions
options.C: 150 millimoles of sodium and 270 millimoles of chloride ions/Lit.
options.D: 270 millimoles of sodium and 150 millimoles of chloride ions/Lit.

questions.explanation: Normal saline (0.9% w/v NaCl) contains approximately 150 mmol/L of both sodium and chloride ions.

questions.question_text: The colour code for Oxygen cylinder is

options.A: Cylinder shoulder painted white and the rest painted black
options.B: Cylinder shoulder painted black and the rest painted white
options.C: Cylinder shoulder painted grey and the rest painted blue
options.D: Cylinder shoulder painted blue and the rest painted grey

questions.explanation: Under standard medical gas color coding (such as Indian/British standards), oxygen cylinders have a white shoulder with the rest of the body painted black.

questions.question_text: Benzocaine is

questions.explanation: Chloral hydrate is a crystalline solid at room temperature.

questions.explanation: Lactic acid is an organic acid used as an acidulant or keratolytic, whereas the others are established antiseptics/disinfectants.

questions.question_text: Proguanil is
questions.explanation: Proguanil is a biguanide derivative used as an antimalarial drug.

questions.question_text: Vitamin K is

questions.question_text: Which among the following is an antimetabolite of folic acid ?
questions.explanation: Methotrexate is a classic folic acid antagonist acting as an antimetabolite.

questions.question_text: The drug used in the treatment of glaucoma
questions.explanation: Physostigmine is an anticholinesterase used to reduce intraocular pressure in glaucoma.

questions.question_text: The sign of Belladonna poisoning
questions.explanation: Belladonna (atropine/anticholinergic) poisoning causes classic anti-muscarinic symptoms: dry mouth, urinary retention (difficulty in micturition), and mydriasis (dilated pupils).

questions.question_text: The drug included in the Dope test for athletes
questions.explanation: Amphetamines are central nervous system stimulants commonly banned and tested for in sports doping controls.

questions.question_text: Ranitidine is
questions.explanation: Ranitidine is a histamine $H_2$ receptor antagonist used to reduce stomach acid secretion.

questions.question_text: The mechanism of the anti-tubercular action of Rifampicin is

options.B: Interference in mycolic acid incorporation in mycobacterial cell wall

questions.question_text: Viagra is

questions.question_text: Which among the following is an ultra-short acting barbiturate ?

questions.question_text: Which among the following is an ACE inhibitor ?

questions.question_text: Which drug among the following is potassium sparing diuretic ?

questions.question_text: The Pharmacy Act was passed in the year
questions.explanation: The Pharmacy Act in India was passed in the year 1948.

questions.explanation: The Director General of Health Services is designated as an ex officio member of the Pharmacy Council of India.

questions.question_text: A drug that is powdered to conceal damage will be a

questions.question_text: Good Manufacturing Practices are given in

questions.question_text: Schedule P is concerned with

questions.question_text: Central Drugs Laboratory is situated in
